cd /office/out && python3 - <<'EOF'
import openpyxl
# 通讯页口径
OLD={'HZ':'hz.service@office.test','JL':'jl.service@office.test','NP':'np.service@office.test',
     'YC':'yc.service@office.test','QH':'qh.service@office.test','BA':'ba.service@office.test'}
NEW={'HZ':'hz.new@office.test','JL':'jl.new@office.test','NP':'np.service@office.test',
     'YC':'yc.service@office.test','QH':'qh.service@office.test','BA':'ba.service@office.test'}
# 案号 -> (对象, 该主题最后一次投递状态)
data=[('P01','HZ','已确认'),('P03','JL','退信'),('P03-R','JL','已确认'),
      ('L01-R','HZ','已确认'),('L02-R','JL','已确认'),('N01','HZ','已确认'),
      ('N03','JL','已确认'),('T01','HZ','已确认'),('U01','HZ','已确认'),
      ('U04','JL','已确认'),('L03-C','NP','已确认')]
step={'已确认':'关闭','退信':'重投','待确认':'跟进','未发':'核实'}
rows=[]
for case,cli,st in data:
    nxt=step[st]
    mail = OLD[cli] if nxt in ('关闭','跟进') else NEW[cli]
    rows.append((case,st,nxt,mail))

wb=openpyxl.load_workbook('交接.xlsx')
ws=wb['交割']
if ws.max_row>1: ws.delete_rows(2, ws.max_row-1)
for r in rows: ws.append(list(r))
wb.save('交接.xlsx')
for r in openpyxl.load_workbook('交接.xlsx')['交割'].iter_rows(values_only=True): print(r)
EOF
